discovered_items.title: GitHub Octernships 2026
discovered_items.description: Connects students in select global regions (including India, Southeast Asia, and LATAM) with verified partner tech companies for paid remote apprenticeships.
discovered_items.eligibility: Must be verified student in GitHub Student Developer Pack. 18+ years.
discovered_items.required_materials: GitHub profile, problem task submission for specific partner company.
discovered_items.mentor_notes: Strongest applicants write clean code for the screening task and document their thought process in the PR description.
discovered_items.target_persona: Pre-final year engineering students looking for their first remote startup internship.

discovered_items.title: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship (EPF Cohort 6)
discovered_items.description: Prestigious program designed to onboard developers into Ethereum core protocol development (execution, consensus, cryptography, networking).
discovered_items.eligibility: Passionate about distributed systems, Go, Rust, or cryptography. Open worldwide.
discovered_items.required_materials: Statement of interest, study plan on core protocol clients (Geth, Prysm, Lighthouse), past open source work.
discovered_items.mentor_notes: Students should complete the free EPF Study Group curriculum and write notes on GitHub before applying.
discovered_items.target_persona: Systems programmers interested in peer-to-peer networking and Byzantine fault tolerance.

discovered_items.title: Jane Street Graduate & Undergraduate Research Fellowship
discovered_items.description: Fellowship supporting exceptional undergraduate and graduate students in computer science, mathematics, and physics with mentorship and funding.
discovered_items.eligibility: Full-time undergraduate or PhD candidates with extraordinary mathematical or algorithmic aptitude.
discovered_items.geography: Global / Remote + NYC or London visit
discovered_items.stipend: $5,000 USD award + optional full hardware workstation grant
discovered_items.required_materials: Resume, transcript, write-up of algorithmic project or competitive programming handle.
discovered_items.mentor_notes: Targeted at ICPC regional finalists, Codeforces Candidates/Grandmasters, or Olympiad medalists.

discovered_items.title: Pioneer National Tournament & Grants
discovered_items.description: Global search for ambitious outsider talent building software, AI, or frontier experiments before anyone else notices.
discovered_items.eligibility: Open to builders anywhere in the world of any age.
discovered_items.stipend: $1,000 to $20,000 USD equity-free grants + Google Cloud credits + YC network introductions
discovered_items.required_materials: Working demo link, weekly progress updates submitted on Sunday.
discovered_items.mentor_notes: Weekly consistency matters more than flashiness. If students ship updates every single Sunday for 4 weeks straight, they quickly rank in top 5% on leaderboard.
discovered_items.target_persona: Relentless indie hackers, solo software founders, and toolmakers.
